title: Part Thirteen: Settled, Contested and Open

sections.brief: What the record settles about Hezbollah 1974-2026, and what is contested with both sides' documented basis (Barak and the counterfactual, the barracks, AMIA, Qana, Majdal Shams, the pagers, arsenal and money estimates, truce counts, who pushed the 2026 war). Figure: compare (Settled / Contested / Open)
What remains open or unknowable as of October 2026, the cycle the record shows, and the verdict on Ron's thesis: what the record supports, what it does not, what is argument. Figures: flow; compare
